criteria.text: Register only rhythm_get_dashboard, rhythm_list_tasks, and rhythm_complete_task as native Rhythm tools; reads use the existing pinned backend client, are bounded and non-mutating, and mark returned user text untrusted.

rhythm_complete_task performs no PATCH unless the current ACP requester returns allow_once for the exact scoped completion. Its single-use receipt binds action, normalized payload, canonical pre-state digest, remote context digest, profile, session, and generation; stale, altered, replayed, cross-session/profile, denied, timed-out, missing-ACP, or changed-state paths perform zero PATCH.
Ambiguous completion transport outcomes are reported as uncertain with no retry or false success; no renderer/model input supplies URL, credentials, user, or workspace authority.
